{{Quote|Nobody calls Bushman Krentz a drunken womp rat! Now&hellip;where'd I leave muh ship?|Bushman Krentz|<ref name="Legacy 38" />}}
'''Bushman Krentz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was regarded as both a [[Alcohol/Legends|drunk]] and an imbecile by his peers. In [[137 ABY]], an intoxicated Krentz was passing through the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when he encountered a beautiful female [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in a dark back alley. Unbeknownst to him, the female was actually the [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Nakia Yoru]]. Nakia tempted Krentz closer and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the pilot by draining Krentz's [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]&mdash;his [[Brain/Legends|brain]] matter&mdash;with the proboscises on her face.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Want to ship my freighter? Come on over here, lover boy.|Nakia Yoru, to Bushman Krentz, before she kills the pilot|<ref name="Legacy 38" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Bushman Krentz was a heavy [[Alcohol/Legends|drinker]] and was thus often insulted by his colleagues. In [[137 ABY]], a drunken Krentz walked through the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], stumbling his way through a desolate back alley at night while he searched for his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], fuming about being derided for his drinking. Although it was quite dangerous to be out at night alone in Mos Eisley, Krentz continued on his way and eventually encountered a female [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] who urged Krentz to come closer.<ref name="Legacy 38" />

[[File:KrentzDeath.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Krentz's death]]
Krentz complied, transfixed on the female's appearance. However, unbeknownst to the pilot, the female was actually an [[Anzat (species)|Anzat]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Nakia Yoru]]. As Krentz approached, Yoru grabbed onto the drunken pilot and, before he could react, inserted her facial proboscises into Krentz's nose, feeding on Krentz's [[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]&mdash;the Anzat term for a being's [[Brain/Legends|brain]] matter and mental essence. With his soup drained, Krentz fell to the ground, [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Legacy 38" />

Nakia, unsatisfied with the amount of soup Krentz had, departed the scene of the murder to find [[Cade Skywalker|another target]], leaving Krentz's corpse lying in the alley.<ref name="Legacy 38" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Boo'ful&hellip;boo'ful gal&hellip;|Bushman Krentz, drunk, easily manipulated by Nakia Yoru due to her appearance|<ref name="Legacy 38" />}}
Bushman Krentz was a drunk who was often ridiculed by his peers because of his habits&mdash;much to his chagrin, he was even called "a drunken [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]]" on one occasion. On the night of his death, his judgment was impaired by his intoxication and he walked alone through a dangerous location in Mos Eisley. He was also easily manipulated by Nakia Yoru, a female whom the pilot believed was very attractive, as she coaxed him toward her and killed him. Krentz had a light skin tone, a [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|beard]], black eyebrows, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Legacy 38" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bushman Krentz appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] issue [[Legacy (2006) 38|38]], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 38" /> on [[July 29]], [[2009]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54410/star_wars_legacy_2006_38|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #38}}</ref> He served as a minor character and was killed off two pages into the issue.<ref name="Legacy 38" />
